title: Canva Resume: How to Make One That Job Portals Can Read (Free Plan Guide)
seoTitle: Canva Resume: Make an ATS-Readable CV on the Free Plan
seoDescription: Make a resume in Canva for free: pick a single-column template, download as PDF Standard, test it by copy-paste, and upload under 2 MB to Naukri.
excerpt: Which Canva templates software can actually read, the right download setting, what the free plan covers versus Pro at ₹4,000 a year, Naukri and LinkedIn file limits, and when to skip Canva entirely.
